text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And the one chosen as the Umamusume of the Year, symbolizing this season, is—

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
"Refusing to yield the lead to anyone,
she has pulled off countless otherworldly front-running masterclasses:
it's Silence Suzuka!"

...Unfortunately, Taiki Shuttle
was unable to seize her dream.

Captivating everyone with her overwhelming power and speed,
her name was etched into the fans' hearts as the undisputed strongest sprinter...
And so, our "first three years" together flew by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sowwy! I ended up heading towards the track by habit,
and got terribly delayed, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was just a little too pumped up
about becoming Uma Musume of the Year this time, so it can't be helped, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
From the day I met you, Trainer, until now,
everything's gone by as speedy as one of my races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I put on quite a show
and made the whole family happy, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, were you happy
to be with me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
Hearing you say that makes me so happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't chosen as Umamusume of the Year,
but that just means I'll have to challenge for it again, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I will keep on running to make everyone even happier from now on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for everything up until now!
And I look forward to working with you from here on out, too!
